title: kernel-v1 adversarial security test constants (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric and policy constants that anchor the adversarial security integration tests (tests/security/). Every security test constant the harnesses read is anchored here; any number not anchored here is a test defect. Covers OIDC token validation, RBAC role hierarchy, PostgreSQL RLS/audit immutability, and policy rollout protocol invariants.

oidc_issuer.description: Expected OIDC issuer (iss claim). Tokens with any other issuer MUST be rejected. Anchored from deploy/compose/config/dex-config.yaml.

oidc_client_id.description: Expected OIDC audience (aud claim). Tokens not containing this audience MUST be rejected.

oidc_token_expiry_s.description: ID token lifetime in seconds (1h from Dex config). Tests craft expired tokens at exp = now - 1.

oidc_iat_skew_s.description: Maximum acceptable clock skew for iat (issued-at) validation. Tokens with iat > now + skew MUST be rejected as future-issued. Mirrors web/src/auth/oidc.ts IAT_SKEW_SEC.

oidc_required_claims.description: Claims that MUST be present in a valid ID token. Missing any claim MUST cause rejection.

rbac_role_hierarchy.description: Ordered role hierarchy (lowest to highest). Each role permits all actions of roles below it. Mirrors crates/auth/src/rbac.rs Role enum ordering.

rls_session_variables.description: PostgreSQL session variables used by RLS policies. Set via SET LOCAL at transaction start. Mirrors crates/control-db/migrations/0006_rls_policies.up.sql.

rls_policy_count.description: Expected number of RLS policies across all tables. Anchored from migration 0006.

audit_immutability.description: audit_log is append-only: INSERT and SELECT permitted; UPDATE and DELETE denied by both role privileges (migration 0007) and RLS default-deny (migration 0006).

control_app.description: Migration 0007 intends control_app as NON-superuser with NOBYPASSRLS. The compose stack creates it as SUPERUSER, which is a critical finding.

db_roles.description: Database role security properties as intended by migrations.

version_monotonic.description: Policy versions MUST be monotonically increasing. Commands with version <= current are rejected (stale/replay protection). Mirrors crates/policy-rollout/src/state_machine/mod.rs invariant.

digest_algorithm.description: Content digest algorithm for policy_versions.content_digest. Hex-encoded SHA-256.

digest_hex_length.description: Expected length of hex-encoded SHA-256 digest.

idempotent_acks.description: Rollout acks are idempotent: UNIQUE(rollout_id, agent_id) prevents duplicate acks.

policy_protocol.description: Policy rollout protocol invariants for adversarial testing.

test_cluster_ids.description: Seeded cluster UUIDs for cross-cluster RLS isolation tests.

spire_deferred.description: SPIRE is NOT running in the dev compose stack. SPIFFE/SVID tests are deferred to the declared self-hosted runner.
